title: Circadian gating of neuroimmune memory: A shared persistence-and-gating hypothesis for chronic pain, depression, and postoperative cognitive dysfunction
title_zh: 神经免疫记忆的昼夜节律调控：适用于慢性疼痛、抑郁症和术后认知功能障碍的持续性与调控共享假说
abstract: Chronic pain, depression, and postoperative cognitive dysfunction provide distinct settings in which inflammatory responses and persistent vulnerability may intersect. Evidence for specific cytokine, synaptic, and microglial mechanisms differs across these conditions and does not establish a single comorbidity mechanism. We examine whether circadian context influences the formation or later expression of neuroimmune memory. Circadian regulation of inflammatory responses and innate immune memory each have experimental support, while their coupling in disease-relevant microglia remains unresolved. Human BCG vaccination studies provide a peripheral timing-and-training precedent, which cannot be assumed to operate in the brain. We distinguish immune memory from ongoing inflammation, neuronal chromatin regulation, and sustained symptoms, and separate cell-autonomous microglial timing from rhythmic environmental inputs. The framework generates distinct tests of imprint formation, maintenance, recall, and reversal. A convincing test requires a resolved first challenge, control of initial inflammatory exposure and recall phase, and cell-resolved molecular measurements coupled to altered secondary-response function. Failure to reverse an established imprint would not exclude a role for timing during its formation. Perioperative studies offer a defined exposure but must distinguish delirium from longer-term cognitive decline. This evidence-calibrated hypothesis specifies what must be demonstrated before circadian interventions can be linked to prevention or modification of neuroimmune memory.
abstract_zh: 慢性疼痛、抑郁症和术后认知功能障碍为研究炎症反应与持续性易感性可能交汇提供了不同的场景。特定细胞因子、突触和小胶质细胞机制在不同疾病间的证据存在差异，并未确立单一的合并症机制。我们考察昼夜节律背景是否影响神经免疫记忆的形成或后续表达。炎症反应和先天免疫记忆的昼夜节律调控均已有实验支持，但在与疾病相关的小胶质细胞中的耦合机制尚未阐明。人类卡介苗接种研究提供了周围定时与训练的范例，但不能假设该机制在脑内同样运作。我们将免疫记忆与持续性炎症、神经元染色质调控和维持症状区分开来，并将小胶质细胞的细胞自主计时与节律性环境输入区分开来。该框架为记忆印记的形成、维持、提取和逆转提供了不同的检验方法。可靠的检验需要明确的首次挑战、对初始炎症暴露和回忆阶段的控制，以及与次级反应功能改变相结合的细胞水平分子测量。未能逆转已建立的印记并不排除计时在其形成过程中所起的作用。围手术期研究提供了明确的暴露，但必须将谵妄与长期认知功能下降区分开来。该经过证据校准的假说明确了在昼夜节律干预可以被关联到神经免疫记忆的预防或修饰之前，必须证明哪些内容。
